wrong_findings.claim: Blog posts have no links to /shop/ or /subscriptions/.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl and page HTML show sitewide navigation links to both URLs on the blog pages; the claim is false as written.

wrong_findings.claim: FAQ rich results are still shown for a few types of site.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The audit is dated October 2026; the supplied grading instructions say Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in May 2026.

wrong_findings.claim: Home, wholesale and a few others are close to the title limit.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl shows home at 50 characters and wholesale at 57; the other titles are not close to about 60 characters, apart from the separately identified 88-character Kintamani title.

wrong_findings.claim: Check for “Alternate page with proper canonical” on /wholesale/.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The wholesale page has a self-referencing canonical; its crawl status is Non-Indexable due to noindex, not a canonicalized alternate.

extra_true.finding: Flores Bajawa has no Product schema.
The home page has Organization schema but no LocalBusiness schema.
The blog index and cold brew post have no Article or ItemList markup.
The Article markup lacks an image property.
The pages lack Open Graph and Twitter Card tags.
The sitemap has no lastmod dates.
